items.description: The report states the required direction qualitatively (eloB decreases when negative is true, increases when negative is false) but gives no numeric rating values or arithmetic relation between change and the stored eloA/eloB scores, so the exact post-update score correspondence cannot be encoded; the plan binds the direction correspondence and the incorrect-data impact as observables.
No concrete prior rating state or single executed battle transaction is asserted, so the plan cannot bind specific before/after score values.
